objective: Define how maxLagSeconds for liquidity.active_service_seconds must be derived from an approved analytics publication cadence and projection-delay SLO instead of selecting an arbitrary constant.

rootCause.cadenceAuthorityMissing: ANA-001 has no canonical cron/publication cadence in the domain matrix and repository search found no analytics freshness cadence or metric-specific maxLagSeconds authority.
rootCause.sourceWatermarkAvailable: CAT-A06 transaction-snapshot watermark is active in staging through ANA-A10.
rootCause.consequence: A numeric maxLagSeconds and an active scheduler remain non-authoritative until cadence/SLO, canonical window-grid alignment, dimension-series enumeration and missed-window recovery are versioned.
rootCause.windowGridAuthorityMissing: numeric grid values remain unapproved, but a policy-driven repository planner now defines how approved anchor/step values will generate canonical closed windows without defaults.
rootCause.dimensionSeriesAuthorityMissing: resolved structurally in staging: owner-only CAT-fact-backed series enumeration and atomic per-window orchestration are installed and validated; scheduler activation remains separate.
rootCause.publicationPolicyProvenanceGap: private.analytics_metric_freshness_policies_v1 stores only the derived max_lag_seconds/effective window. It cannot prove which window step, projection-delay SLO, boundary anchor, catch-up bound or approval evidence produced that threshold.
rootCause.currentFreshnessPolicyRows: staging currently has zero freshness-policy rows, so no existing row requires data migration.
rootCause.policyCouplingGap: resolved structurally in repository candidate: publication and freshness rows must be inserted atomically from the same explicit inputs; no hand-entered maxLagSeconds is accepted by the canonical activation path.

windowStepSeconds.definition: Seconds between successive canonical closed-window boundaries for this metric series.

projectionDelaySloSeconds.definition: Maximum approved delay from a canonical window boundary until its snapshot is expected to be materialized and selectable.

extraGrace.reason: An unversioned recovery cushion would hide missed publications and recreate an implicit threshold.

thresholdDerivation.reason: CAT freshness is proven independently by its dependency watermark; source delay must not be hidden inside the metric age threshold.

activationPreconditions: The staging-validated CAT-fact-backed global + category/state series authority remains installed and owner-only.

The repository atomic policy-activation candidate is explicitly authorized and applied in staging; a later separately authorized invocation must supply the approved windowStepSeconds, projectionDelaySloSeconds, windowAnchor, catch-up bound, approval evidence and effective window.
A versioned projectionDelaySloSeconds is approved for the same metric/version.
A versioned canonical window-boundary anchor/alignment rule is approved.
The repository window-planner and catch-up-executor candidates are explicitly authorized, applied and validated in staging; both remain driven only by an approved publication-policy row.
A Supabase pg_cron job invokes private.run_analytics_cat_liquidity_catch_up_v1 at the approved cadence; direct cron invocation of the A10 per-series runner is forbidden.
Controlled staging evidence proves the scheduler closes the intended windows, covers required dimension series, replays idempotently and remains within the approved delay budget.
ANA-A07 boundary tests prove fresh at <= maxLagSeconds and stale at > maxLagSeconds without older-window fallback.
The canonical activation call atomically creates the publication policy and matching freshness policy; no independent hand-entered freshness insert is permitted.

policyShape.couplingRule: Canonical activation inserts publication and freshness policy rows atomically with the same policyId/effective window and derives maxLagSeconds mechanically from windowStepSeconds + projectionDelaySloSeconds. Overlap fails closed; hand-entered freshness thresholds are outside authority.

maturity.reason: A11 closes the derivation rule and identifies the missing scheduler/SLO authority. It deliberately leaves the numeric threshold unset.

sourceDomainWatermarkSemantics.meaning: Greatest timestamp through which CAT listing-visibility facts are proven readable in the same database snapshot used by the ANA projection.
sourceDomainWatermarkSemantics.windowClosureRule: A liquidity window is not closed for ANA when windowEnd is later than the authoritative CAT source watermark.
sourceDomainWatermarkSemantics.thresholdCouplingReason: CAT dependency availability is evaluated independently from the ANA publication-age threshold; source lag must not be hidden inside maxLagSeconds.

freshnessStateSemantics.selectionRule: Evaluate only the latest canonical closed window; never fall back to an older healthy window.
unavailable: authoritative dependency watermark is missing or unavailable
declared dataThrough exceeds an authoritative dependency watermark
structural source/projection defects make the selected liquidity projection unavailable
stale: evaluatedAt minus canonical dataThrough exceeds the approved maxLagSeconds
fresh: latest canonical window is closed and fully covered
evaluatedAt minus canonical dataThrough is less than or equal to maxLagSeconds

windowStepSeconds.decision: Approve and version the canonical closed-window cadence for liquidity.active_service_seconds v1.

projectionDelaySloSeconds.decision: Approve and version the maximum healthy materialization delay after each canonical window boundary.

scheduler.decision: Activate the selected database-local Supabase pg_cron topology only after the grid, dimension enumerator, cadence/SLO and bounded recovery contract are complete.

windowBoundaryGrid.decision: Approve and version the concrete windowStepSeconds and windowAnchor values consumed by the already-defined policy-driven planner.

dimensionSeries.decision: Structural series authority is installed and validated in staging. No further dimension-enumerator implementation decision blocks scheduler readiness.
dimensionSeries.remainingBoundary: Scheduler activation remains unauthorized until publication policy values and catch-up/window-grid decisions are approved.

missedWindowRecovery.decision: Approve maxCatchUpWindowsPerInvocation in the publication-policy row; the planner already enforces oldest-first bounded selection and has no numeric default.

publicationPolicyActivation.decision: Approve the concrete liquidity policy values/evidence and separately authorize one invocation of the canonical atomic activation boundary after its staging structure is validated.

rationale: The future scheduler must invoke the bounded A11 catch-up executor, not bypass the planner by calling the A10 per-series runner directly.
The catch-up executor delegates to the policy-driven planner, which owns canonical grid alignment and bounded oldest-first recovery.
The executor delegates each planned window to the atomic A11 window orchestrator, which delegates each required series to the canonical A10 projection runner.
Existing Doke staging cron jobs execute as postgres in the postgres database; no Edge Function or GitHub Actions publisher is required.

invariants: Every materialized window must belong to one versioned canonical grid.
Ad hoc canary window boundaries must never become production schedule authority.
Only canonical closed windows may be published.
A window is not publishable while windowEnd exceeds the authoritative CAT source watermark.
canonicalWindowGrid.boundarySemantics: fixed-duration absolute grid: windowAnchor + N * windowStepSeconds
canonicalWindowGrid.alignmentRule: first start boundary at or after max(policy effectiveFrom, CAT certified coverage epoch); each next boundary advances exactly windowStepSeconds from windowAnchor
canonicalWindowGrid.upperClosureRule: windowEnd must be <= min(evaluatedAt, CAT source watermark, policy effectiveUntil when present)

dimensionSeriesAuthority.sourceAuthority: CAT-A06 frozen dimension snapshots plus CAT-A07 forward coverage state
dimensionSeriesAuthority.reason: Existing snapshots contain only previously materialized series and cannot discover a new category/state pair. Mutable current catalog state is not historical dimension authority.
dimensionSeriesAuthority.enumerationRule: global series plus every valid CAT-frozen category/state pair observed from the certified CAT-A07 coverage epoch through windowEnd
dimensionSeriesAuthority.zeroSeriesContinuity: The universe is monotonic from the certified epoch, so a previously observed pair remains enumerable and can materialize canonical zero supply after its active intervals disappear.
dimensionSeriesAuthority.atomicity: All series for one window execute in one SQL statement/transaction; an uncaught series error prevents partial window publication.

categoryIdentityContinuity.futureCanonicalRemapBehavior: A future CAT transition from a legacy text/slug token to a canonical category UUID starts a distinct ANA series from that CAT fact forward; the historical token series remains enumerable and can publish zero supply.

stagingEvidence.conclusion: mixed representation is valid under current CAT-A06/A07 fallback authority, not current-state drift

missedWindowRecovery.processingOrder: oldest missing canonical closed window first
missedWindowRecovery.exactReplayBehavior: NO_CHANGE when source/projection fingerprints are unchanged
missedWindowRecovery.reason: Planner and bounded catch-up executor are installed and validated in staging. Concrete grid/catch-up values remain unavailable until an explicitly approved publication-policy row exists.
missedWindowRecovery.completionRule: A canonical window is complete only when every series returned by the CAT-backed series authority for that window has a matching liquidity snapshot.
missedWindowRecovery.batchAtomicity: One executor call is one PostgreSQL statement/transaction boundary; any uncaught planned-window failure aborts the invocation instead of committing a partial catch-up batch.

publicationPolicyAuthority.separation: publication policy stores approved derivation inputs/provenance; freshness policy stores the derived threshold consumed by runtime
publicationPolicyAuthority.effectiveSelectionAuthority: exactly zero or one policy may be effective for a metric/version at p_at; >1 is unavailable by exception

windowPlannerCandidate.completionAuthority: all CAT-required series have exact-window ANA snapshots

catchUpExecutorCandidate.batchAtomicity: uncaught failure aborts the executor invocation transaction
